blocked_candidates.reason: Source personal dismissal threshold includes outdated vägande requirement. Related warning and employee-rights cards remain possible, but this exact threshold is blocked.
Current law permits specified first fixed-term contracts without a justified reason; source blanket requirement is obsolete. Source lacks date for a historical question.

verification_sources.findings: Current personal dismissal threshold is sakligt skäl; old sakligt och vägande wording must not be taught unchanged. Probationary cancellation cannot be discriminatory or unrelated to probation. Written-information duty and employment certificate are statutory safeguards.
Valvira ceased; new national supervisory agency grants professional rights from 2026-01-01. Existing authorizations remain valid.
FPA labor market subsidy and basic unemployment allowance were replaced by general social security benefit in May 2026.
Current layoff guidance says at least seven days or applicable agreement deadline, contradicting source general fourteen-day rule.
Written terms normally required where no written agreement; low-hours exception exists.
Uninsured employees retain compensation rights; source denial blocked.
2026 first-contract fixed-term exception confirms source blanket reason requirement obsolete.
Work-right records retained two years, contradicting source four-year claim.
Working time, consent, Sunday premium and roster rules; qualifications retained.
Holiday accrual and qualification year; fuller annual-holiday rules used with source context.
Variable-hours review and actual labor needs; twelve-month review cycle.
Section 23 right to refuse serious danger with notification and proportionality.
Statutory preventive occupational health for all employees.
Ordinary three-month deadline; serious-crime exceptions preserved by normally.
Exploitation permit requires qualifying existing work-based residence rights and other conditions.
Employment-service work trial maximum six months.
Startup grant supports livelihood, initially six months with up to twelve total.
Initial four-month entrepreneurship assessment exception; source blanket benefit exclusion blocked.
FöPL insurance deadline and confirmed work-income impact on social protection.
Free advisory service also open to nonmembers, corroborated by current InfoFinland guidance.
Current FFC advice service and workplace support channels.
Alko state ownership and special retail role; no blanket cross-border sales prohibition tested.
Rental income is capital income; no rate memorization.
Check and correct return; tax decision reconciles annual liability.
A1 demonstrates other-country social-insurance coverage, not universal tax exemption.
Qualifying nonresidents can request progressive taxation; short stay does not imply universal exemption.
